name: ADHD Pomodoro
author: abdullah
description: ADHD-friendly Pomodoro timer: visible countdown in the bar, gentle pre-warnings, plain-text task labels, and a per-day session log.

service.summary: Owns the Pomodoro timer state, persists to state.json, and fires phase-transition notifications.

barWidget.description: Bar countdown with phase glyph, task label, and progress dots toward the daily goal. Click to open the panel; right-click to pause; middle-click to skip the current phase.
